mapper.sql: id, username, nickname, avatar, password_hash, status, review_note, reviewed_at, reviewed_by, invite_code, register_ip, created_at, last_login_at

where.if: and (username like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or nickname like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select: select u.id, u.username, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.password_hash, u.status, u.review_note, u.reviewed_at, u.reviewed_by, u.invite_code, u.register_ip, u.created_at, u.last_login_at from app_user u inner join app_user_identity i on i.user_id = u.id where i.type = #{type} and i.identifier = #{identifier} limit 1
select id, status, review_note from app_user where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into app_user (username, nickname, avatar, password_hash, status, invite_code, register_ip) values (#{username}, #{nickname}, #{avatar,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, #{passwordHash,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{status}, #{inviteCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{registerIp,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.update: update app_user set last_login_at = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select status as status, count(1) as cnt from app_user group by status
